parameters.jsCode: const source=$input.first().json;const body=source.body&&typeof source.body==='object'?source.body:source;const date=String(body.date||'');if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date))throw new Error('INVALID_DATE');const finite=(value,min,max)=>typeof value==='number'&&Number.isFinite(value)&&value>=min&&value<=max?value:undefined;const metrics={steps:finite(body.steps,0,200000),sleepMinutes:finite(body.sleepMinutes,0,1440),restingHeartRate:finite(body.restingHeartRate,20,250),averageStress:finite(body.averageStress,0,100),intensityMinutes:finite(body.intensityMinutes,0,1440),activeCalories:finite(body.activeCalories,0,20000),bodyBatteryLow:finite(body.bodyBatteryLow,0,100),bodyBatteryHigh:finite(body.bodyBatteryHigh,0,100),activities:finite(body.activities,0,100)};return [{json:{snapshotId:'garmin:'+date,date,source:'GARMIN_CONNECT',quality:String(body.quality||'PARTIAL').slice(0,40),occurredAt:typeof body.occurredAt==='number'?body.occurredAt:Date.now(),baselineRestingHeartRate:finite(body.baselineRestingHeartRate,20,250),baselineSleepMinutes:finite(body.baselineSleepMinutes,0,1440),metrics}}];
